description: Create a new draft film from a title (optionally with its age_rating and content_descriptors), exactly as the Studio's add-film dialog does. The draft starts as Buy or rent with no prices, no poster and no files, and is not public until publish_film. Returns the film's id, editor link and publish checklist (the same shape as get_film), so the next steps are update_film (details, access: free or paid, prices), start_film_upload (main film), the poster in the film editor, then publish_film.

age_rating.description: Age rating of the whole title (a series' rating covers every episode): all = All ages, 13 = 13+, 16 = 16+, 18 = 18+. An 18+ title asks viewers to confirm they're 18 or over before it plays. Sexual content or nudity makes a film 18+. Optional here (set it later with update_film); publishing needs one.

content_descriptors.description: Content descriptors shown on the film page: none = None of these apply, sexual-content = Sexual content, nudity = Nudity, violence = Violence, strong-language = Strong language, drug-use = Drug use, disturbing = Horror / disturbing scenes. The list is replaced as a whole; choose none explicitly when no warnings apply. An empty list clears the answer and must be completed before publishing. Sexual content or nudity makes a film 18+. (age_rating must be 18 — the call is refused otherwise).

kind.description: feature (default) = a single film with one main video; series = seasons of episodes, each with its own video, built with add_season and add_episode. A title's kind is set here and not changed through this connection.

title.description: The film's title (up to 200 characters); everything else is set afterwards.
